referenceRole: Each original board is a visual family reference for two new developments.

variants.name: 聚拢
variants.subtitle: 保留三枚独立块面，让符号更紧凑
variants.lead: 圆润、亲切，收藏感更直接。
variants.detail: 保留三枚不规则块面的识别，让外轮廓和间隙更稳定；橘红色主导，宽厚字标与散布图形强化轻松感。
variants.prompt:
Use-case: logo-brand. Create a NEW professional Aarre brand identity development board based on the supplied approved brand reference. The supplied image is a FAMILY AND ART-DIRECTION REFERENCE, not a layout to copy. This is a close creative development of that chosen direction, not an unrelated new identity. Preserve the recognizable color world and core emotional quality of the reference, while deliberately refining the emblem, custom wordmark, graphic system and practical digital product applications as described below. Output one fully designed opaque 1536 x 1024 landscape 3:2 board. Exact product name everywhere: "Aarre". Use ONLY one consistent refined emblem per board and reproduce it faithfully in all applications.

Deliver a compelling complete brand system: large crisp emblem + Aarre lockup, precise palette/type mini-specimen, flat one-ink mark on light and dark surfaces, app icon at large and small sizes, one clean straight-on product browser with actual Aarre collection cards and a compact branded "Save to Aarre" panel, and an editorial graphic application that extends the mark into a brand language. Also show a narrow right-edge floating product handle with this exact emblem. If showing a conversation interface, use one integrated bottom input labelled "Ask your collection" rather than a separate AI tab. Keep the compact save panel's type and controls human-sized with concise readable labels: "Title", "Collection", "Note", "Save". Product applications should be small, focused and believable, not oversized airy dialogs. No unrelated product icon. No invented third-party brand, watermarks, fake citations or agency labels. This is a personal web collection tool, never a finance dashboard.

Give the emblem clear robust counterspaces and a memorable compact silhouette that survives tiny icon use; no hairlines, glitter, stock bookmark/star/diamond/lightbulb, mascots or excessive rendering. Flat solid logo is essential. A controlled dimensional or physical brand application is optional only as a minor supporting element, not the principal mark. Short English copy only; sharp elegant typography, no dense paragraphs or gibberish. A deliberately designed asymmetric agency case-study board, expressive hierarchy and scale, not a generic equal-tile logo contact sheet. The letters A a r r e must be correct. 
FAMILY: CABINET / 拾集. DEVELOPMENT A1: CLOSE-KNIT PEBBLES.
Keep the reference's poppy orange #F2633D, cream #F9F0D5, lavender #D1C9E9 and deep aubergine #392B3A. Preserve its emblem idea of THREE independent found-object pebbles. Refine them to a compact asymmetric triangular cluster with gently squared rounded facets, one upper piece and two unequal lower pieces; carefully balanced optical gaps and chunky friendly silhouette. Retain visible clean gaps so it remains a cluster, not a clover, flower, paw print, heart or jewel. Make the three pieces feel collected and held together. Orange is the hero color. Evolve the Aarre wordmark to a very confident wide soft heavy sans, smooth open counters, slight characteristic angled cut to the final e, modest not childish. Flat cream emblem on an orange app tile must be excellent.
LAYOUT: an orange brand hero with large cream wordmark and exact line "Good finds, together." The right side shows a cream collection browser and modest warm save panel. Lower band includes an elegant three-pebble repeating pattern where a few orange and lavender objects make a rhythm on cream, true flat one-ink mark samples, a restrained Aa specimen and four palette swatches. Give more prominence to real icon use and the floating edge handle than to lifestyle photography. Have a small beautiful photographic editorial card of one sculptural everyday found object with the brand lockup. Carefully art-directed warm and tactile, yet clean modern consumer software.

variants.name: 拼合
variants.subtitle: 让三枚块面组成更完整的轮廓
variants.lead: 依然轻松，但更有秩序和包容感。
variants.detail: 把三块图形拼成更完整的收纳轮廓，保留宽裕的留白缝隙；奶油色与淡紫色占比提高，字标更舒展。

Retain exactly the warm playful poppy-orange/cream/lavender/aubergine palette and the THREE found-object idea from the reference. Broad curves and one subtle flat edge per piece; not a triangular gemstone, pinwheel, flower, clover or generic three-circle logo. No extra enclosing outline. The complete symbol should read as a single icon footprint on a 24px app tile. Use lavender and cream as larger surfaces and orange as a strong accent. Include two tasteful brand cards, light/dark one-ink icon specimens and a measured typography/palette strip. Strong editorial composition and calmer energy than the orange-dominant sibling. No need to reproduce the reference board's panel layout.

variants.name: 方环
variants.subtitle: 收紧几何与转角，强调清晰稳定
variants.lead: 辨识直接，像一件可靠的数字工具。
variants.detail: 以原来的 a 形回环为基础，调整转角和开口的秩序；钴蓝保持强识别，图标与紧凑界面的关系更统一。

FAMILY: CURRENT / 回流. DEVELOPMENT B1: PRECISE RETURN.
Keep the approved reference's vivid cobalt #224AFF, icy white #F5F7FF, midnight #111735 and small acid-yellow #E8FB58 accents. Keep its distinctive lowercase-a-like RETURN LOOP as the structural starting point. Refine the same idea into a compact squared continuous path with optically uniform broad stroke, two clean rounded turns, a stable off-center square counter and one clear deliberate opening. Clean up awkward inward corners and uneven joins from the original. Crisp, sturdy, unmistakably an evolved a/return-path symbol, not an infinity sign, chain, power button or random letter. Same refined mark everywhere, flat single ink. Create an assertive custom Aarre grotesk with cleaner spacing, solid proportions and squared-soft terminal details shared with the symbol; do not merely type a generic default font.
LAYOUT: sharp asymmetric Swiss grid. White and cobalt alternate in three big purposeful zones. Hero lockup on cobalt, exact line "Everything worth returning to." Clean browser collection application with a compact save panel and clearly visible edge handle, white/gray content and blue actions. A large monochrome logo construction-like silhouette specimen demonstrates simplified counterspace, but no fake geometry/math diagrams. Include 16 / 24 / 48 icon scale examples as visual samples, typography specimen, four palette chips and a cropped repeat of the refined symbol as a campaign graphic. More mature, quieter and more precise than the reference, retaining its impact. No gradients or glossy 3D; no random books and mugs. Product credibility and icon clarity matter.

variants.name: 旋流
variants.subtitle: 放松直角，让回环更有动势
variants.lead: 更轻快、更连续，突出重新发现的感觉。
variants.detail: 保留钴蓝与回环识别，让路径更流畅、开口更鲜明；用放大的回环曲线组织版面，增加速度感和轻盈感。

variants.name: 新芽
variants.subtitle: 保留双瓣回环，增加生长感
variants.lead: 自然、亲切，有一点向上的活力。
variants.detail: 延续松绿与嫩黄色，修整双瓣回环的轮廓和内孔；更明亮的配色比例与柔和字标表达自然生长。

Cheerful restorative contemporary product branding, quietly optimistic, no rustic eco-packaging, excessive nature stock shots or decorative foliage around every corner.

variants.name: 林隙
variants.subtitle: 拉开内侧留白，强调围合与安静
variants.lead: 更沉静、更耐看，像保存好东西的小小空间。
variants.detail: 把有机回环调整为更开阔的围合形，放大内侧留白；深松绿、亚麻白与轻量字标形成更克制的表达。
